comment: Query golden vectors (P3 slice 1) — the shared parity corpus for the query-AST v2 surface: one seeded mini-workspace (TS-schema derived rows, the packages/query semantics reference) + AST cases with expectations generated by the TS reference runner (scripts/query/gen-golden.mjs in this repo — packages/query over better-sqlite3, the TS store schema). Flutter vendors this file byte-identical and replays the same seed through its local schema renames (node_cache uuid/name/classes_uuid, node_uuid, is_active -> is_deleted/is_archived, search_index_fts) — one source of truth, two runners. ids are stored SORTED (the plain-query row order is SQLite-undefined); the order-pinned cases use orderedIds. now pins are local-time ISO strings (no offset) resolved identically by both runners.

cases.name: content contains is a LIKE substring over the plaintext
content contains matches across the folded plaintext only where present
content fts is prefix-AND over the tokens
content eq is the full-plaintext equality
content exists is the non-empty probe
name contains reads the flattened title
name eq is exact and case-sensitive
member class in ids is closure-aware over extends
member class exact is the single-class equality
member class in query targets the class rows (the fixture shape)
member class not-in negates the closure
member class exists / a not-wrap reads is-set
member tags in ids is the literal tag probe
member tags in query resolves the tags dynamically
member tags not-exists is the untagged read
member links in ids is backlinksWithRollup
member links exists is the inbound-edge probe
member parent in ids is the direct-parent read
member child in ids finds the parents
member childPath in ids is the strict subtree
member page in ids is the containing-page read
member parentPath in ids walks the strict ancestors
member root in ids is the workspace-root ancestor
member referencePath in ids is the self-or-ancestor rollup
member child in self is hosted by the run site
member page in self resolves the hosting page
an or-group unions its children
property eq matches an authored value
property gt compares numerically over the effective rows
property eq derives the class-binding default
property eq includeDefaults false reads authored rows only
property eq 999 sees the tombstone-suppressed row as absent
property between spans the inclusive range over defaults
property eq with an ISO date speaks to the date-node ref
date created eq is the whole local day
date created gte compares against the instant
date updated within today resolves the pinned clock
date created between spans the inclusive range
nodeField isClass eq true targets the class rows
nodeField coverAsset exists is the set bit
nodeField aliasedNode neq is unset-blind (NULL matches neither)
the pages scope is the document-chrome read
the subtree scope walks the recursive set
the linkedTo scope is the roll-up membership
archived rows stay out of every query
sort by name is the NOCASE title order (orderedIds)
sort by createdAt desc nulls-last with the id tiebreak
aggregation count groups by the isClass dimension
aggregation avg over the effective property values
count over the compiled select
matches is the single-node membership probe
